name: Spectator
epithet: The one who is always in the room
description: A pathway of watching, listening past the words, and eventually of putting things into heads that were not there before. Its powers make people legible — which is exactly the trade an investigator is in, and exactly the trade that ruins one. A Spectator who reads too much stops being sure which thoughts are their own.

sequences.title: Spectator
sequences.description: You have become very good at being present. Objects give up the shape of the hands that held them, and rooms tell you where the attention in them is pointed. None of it is loud. All of it is more than you had.
sequences.narrative: You drank it in the gallery of a lecture theatre with forty strangers below you, because the Hermit said the role wanted an audience to spectate. For a week afterwards you could not stop cataloguing people.

requirements.label: Close a case for the Club
Obtain the Telepathist formula (the Club’s, or a copy)
Digest the Spectator potion — watch, and keep watching

advancement.ritualText: The Club's back room is cleared but for two chairs, and Ilma sits in the second one and does not speak, because the rite wants somebody to be observed. You mark the circle. Then you drink, and for a moment you are sitting in the other chair looking back.

temptation.label: Drink it now, before you have finished looking
temptation.description: The bottle is in your hand and you have not finished being a Spectator. What comes next will arrive in your own voice, and you will not be certain it is yours.

sequences.title: Telepathist
sequences.description: The surface of a mind is now a thing you can read the way you read a face — badly, in fragments, and never without paying for it. What arrives comes in your own voice, and telling the difference is a skill you had better learn quickly.
sequences.narrative: It came on quietly and then all at once, in a tram carriage, where eleven people were thinking eleven things and you were suddenly holding all of them. You got off two stops early and walked the rest in the rain.

requirements.label: Digest the Telepathist potion — hear people out, in public
Be seen listening to somebody who needed it

advancement.ritualText: You take the rite alone this time, which the Hermit disapproves of and permits. A Telepathist advancing in company hears too much of what the company thinks of the odds.

temptation.label: Drink it now, and sort out whose thoughts are whose later
temptation.description: You are still carrying fragments that came from other people. Adding a rank on top of them is how a Telepathist stops being able to say 'I'.

sequences.title: Psychiatrist
sequences.description: You have stopped merely reading and started prescribing. A question asked in the right register is answered honestly by people who had every intention of lying, and a door held by a nervous man opens because you have quietly relieved him of the nervousness.
sequences.narrative: Afterwards you sat with a man who had not slept in nine days and talked him down in under an hour, and enjoyed it, and that is the part you keep turning over.

requirements.label: Digest the Psychiatrist potion — treat somebody, properly

advancement.ritualText: The Hermit reads the method aloud while you mark the circle, and stops twice to ask whether you are certain, which is the closest he comes to affection.

temptation.label: Drink it now, and let the suggestion take root anyway
temptation.description: Half-digested, the next role will not wait to be invited. It will start suggesting things to you.

sequences.title: Hypnotist
sequences.description: You can hand a person a conviction and they will carry it out of the room believing they packed it themselves. Everything you do now is a thing done to somebody, whether or not you meant it that way.
sequences.narrative: You told a man on the Ashfen tram that he had left his window open, and he went home and closed a window that had been shut all week, and thanked you. Nothing about that was difficult. That is the trouble.
